title: Seismic resistance.
officialText:
When earthquake loads are applicable in accordance with the New York City Building Code, mechanical
system supports shall be designed and installed for the seismic forces in accordance with the New York City Building Code.
SECTION MC 302
PROTECTION OF STRUCTURE
